change_class: ADDITIVE — the call-ledger receipt `ledger` {id, leaf, verify} (vault Prompt/call-ledger-contract.md § Receipt); rule_version stays 2. No key is removed, renamed or re-typed; an internal caller's response differs by nothing, and every other caller's differs only by the one appended `ledger` key.
change_note: DECISION-CALL-V2-W5 CH1: every LOGGED check — served, billed, non-internal, the check log's own predicate, decided once in toPreTradeCheckResponse — carries `ledger`: `id` (`pcl_` + 32 lowercase hex, 16 CSPRNG bytes), `leaf` (the verdict leaf, `0x` + 64 hex: k(k(TAG_VERDICT ‖ k(JCS(record)))) over the served v, tool, id, as_of, coin, side, size_usd, hold_hours, timeframe, order_type, leverage, stop_pct, target_pct, decision, venue = best_venue.exchange, rule_version and rules[{id, source, result}] in served order) and `verify` (`verify://check/` + id). The leaf is committed to a daily Merkle root on Base; verify://check/{id} serves its proof. Never served: the record itself, an odds value, the odds leaf's salt, equity, the caller or a cost.
source: src/tools/pre-trade-check.ts (runPreTradeCheck, toPreTradeCheckResponse, mintReceipt) + src/lib/call-ledger.ts (the v1 records, JCS, both leaves) + src/lib/pre-trade-check-log.ts (the check row and both call_ledger leaves, migrations/055) + src/lib/tool-call-pipeline.ts (logs exactly the responses that carry `ledger`)
saved_rules_note: `applied` is true when the API key has a saved profile and this call read it (an empty profile included, and even when the call's own rules override every saved key); `updated_at` is that profile's last save, ISO-8601, else null. Never the profile's owner, its key or its pseudonym.
rules_note: `rules` lists only ACTIVE rules (sent, saved, or a default not switched off), in rule_ids order; `source` names the layer that set each: `yours` (this call), `saved` (the API key's profile) or `default`. `limit` is a number or true; `value` is the metric read (a number, the regime label, a boolean for noLiqBeforeStop) or null when not_evaluated, whose `detail` names what to send or what is missing.
ledger_note: Present on every logged check (served, billed, non-internal) and on no other response: an internal caller and every refusal carry none. `id` is `pcl_` + 32 lowercase hex; `leaf` the verdict leaf, `0x` + 64 lowercase hex; `verify` = `verify://check/` + id, where the leaf's Merkle proof and its Base root are served once anchored. The leaf commits the served values themselves, so a caller can rebuild it from this response alone (contract § Verdict record v1).
calc_note: Every calc figure is null when an input it needs is absent — never a guessed 0. `win_rate_needed_pct` and `random_entry_target_first_pct` are break-even arithmetic on the caller's own stop and target, not a claim about any trade.
algovault_note: `exchange` and `venue_status` name the best venue and appear only when there is one; `upgrade_hint`, `tier_warning` and `quota` follow the caller's tier exactly as get_market_regime's envelope does.

error_contract.transport: MCP: every refusal is a structured JSON text payload with isError:true. x402 HTTP (POST /x402/pre_trade_check): the same payload with `status` as the HTTP status, unsettled.

invalid_parameter.note: v2 adds the params leverage (1-200), stopPct (0.01-50), targetPct (0.01-1000), equityUsd (> 0, <= 1e10), orderType (market | limit) and the object rules (closed: an unknown key refuses with param rules.<key>; a value outside its rule's type or bounds likewise). On MCP the SDK's schema check may refuse first, also unbilled; on x402 HTTP ajv refuses before the payment is claimed.

quota wall (TierLimitReachedError).note: thrown and rendered by buildTierLimitPayload exactly as get_market_regime's wall — quota-surfaces row refusal:pre_trade_check

error_contract.order: invalid_parameter → venue_not_supported → quota wall → data_unavailable → coin_not_listed; nothing before the decision is billed

forbidden_keys_note: The contract forbids a `call`, `verdict`, `reasoning`, `price_at_signal` or any `outcome_*` key, a proposed side, and an edge / return / win-rate claim: this tool checks an order the caller already chose; it never reads or serves AlgoVault's directional call and never proposes a side. `descriptionRef` and `signal_hash` are internal identifiers. v2 adds: never a suggested size, leverage, stop or target, and never a probability that the trade works.
consumers: MCP tools/list + tools/call (served; publicly listed since DOCS-PRE-TRADE-CHECK-LISTING-W1: the nav, /docs#pre-trade-check, /tools, llms.txt and the LobeHub manifest)
x402 HTTP POST /x402/pre_trade_check ($0.02, Bazaar-declared input schema)
the internal pre_trade_checks log (migrations/051, DECISION-CALL-V2-W1 CH3): decision, decision venue, rules and per-venue figures of each served billed non-internal call — never on a public surface

cache_contract.description: Nothing in the response is cached per caller. The inputs are the shared venue-market-state caches (venue universes 60 s single-flight, the merged funding snapshot 30 s per adapter), the newest fresh servable bar-close regime generation and the newest fresh 1h generation for sigma (regime_snapshots, read-only), and — only when leverage is sent — each venue's maintenance tier table, cached 24 h per (venue, coin) single-flight. A keyed call's saved profile is read on every call (one primary-key read), never cached.
cache_contract.client_cache_refresh: an open MCP session sees the new optional params after it re-fetches tools/list; a client that never does keeps calling with the v1 params, which still decide exactly as v1 did

drift_check_command: curl -fsS -X POST https://api.algovault.com/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}' | sed -n 's/^data: //p' | jq -e '.result.tools[] | select(.name == "pre_trade_check") | .inputSchema.properties | has("leverage") and has("stopPct") and has("orderType") and has("rules")' >/dev/null && echo SHAPE_OK
